comment_text:
I feel like there needs to be an age restriction for e-bikes. Too many little kids riding them around here & not paying attention to other drivers. I watched a guy on a scooter cross 2 lanes in front of cars almost causing an accident today, 2 little kids riding an e bike 2 days ago that almost caused a lot of accidents going into a busy road area & told them to be careful out there, & then months ago I saw a little boy riding on the street like a car in traffic with his e bike!! Stop the madness!! If you care about your kids, teach them to wear helmets & follow the rules of sidewalks, cars, stop signs, etc. just because they are riding those things doesn’t mean they are above the law. It’s a major safety issue here along with the golf carts. 

Pay more attention PARENTS & get off your phones.
